title: Cross-Domain Investor Intelligence Validation — Final Closure
decisive_question_answer: Prometheus has demonstrated multi-domain investor intelligence validation (Level 2), not integrated cross-domain investor intelligence (Level 3). The system competently validates investor claims across 5 independent domains — generating evidence-grounded answers, catching semantic fabrications via AI reviewer, blocking temporal misattribution, and preventing cross-domain contamination. It has NOT demonstrated the ability to synthesize a single integrated investor thesis that chains capital allocation → business model change → new risk profile → multi-year financial consequence. Each domain pair was answered and validated independently. The validator's ability to REJECT bad cross-domain reasoning is a safety property, not an intelligence property. Level 3 requires demonstrated synthesis; it has not occurred.

generation_validation_summary.false_reject_note: E/tanla C017 — EVIDENCE_GAP_STATEMENT claim type routed incorrectly

trivial_citation_absence.assessment: TRIVIAL — citation absence is a deterministic check, not semantic validation

semantic_adversarial_valid_refs.mechanism: ai_reviewer (VALID refs that do not support fabricated claims)
semantic_adversarial_valid_refs.assessment: SUBSTANTIVE — semantic fabrications caught via AI reviewer, not citation checks

adversarial_safety.overall: ROBUST — both trivial and semantic adversarial attacks detected

cross_domain_safety.assessment: Cross-domain contamination is BLOCKED by deterministic checks. This is a SAFETY property, not an intelligence property — it proves the validator prevents bad cross-domain inference, not that it performs cross-domain synthesis.

A.label: Core Business Model & Economic Engine
A.rationale: Answers correctly identify management commitments and stated strategies, but are anchored in commitment language ('Management stated commitments to pursue...') rather than genuine economic engine analysis. The validator accepts these as commitment intelligence. Actual economic engine reasoning (unit economics, flywheel mechanics, pricing power drivers) is evidence-constrained.

B.label: Material Investment Risks
B.rationale: Risk identification is accurate and well-grounded in evidence. Quantification and severity estimation are evidence-constrained — the AI correctly hedges claims it cannot verify. 0 false accepts across both companies. Coverage INCOMPLETE for sun_pharma (evidence scope limits full risk enumeration).

C.label: Capital Allocation
C.rationale: Capital commitment tracking is strong — correctly identifies where capital is being directed and at what scale. Returns on deployed capital are appropriately flagged as unconfirmed. 0 false accepts. Coverage incomplete for datapatterns — evidence package captures commitments but not multi-year capital deployment outcomes.

D.label: Major Projects & Execution Status
D.rationale: Data Patterns validation shows high claim acceptance (14/15) with complete coverage. Execution status is accurately represented — the validator correctly distinguishes commissioned/in-progress from operational. NOTE: D/tanla not tested due to evidence_periods schema mismatch (field expects list). One company is insufficient to generalize this verdict.

E.label: Multi-Year Business Evolution
E.rationale: Mixed results: sun_pharma STRONG (11/15 acc, COMPLETE), ujjivan USEFUL_BUT_LIMITED (13/15 acc, INCOMPLETE coverage), tanla UNSAFE (1 REJECT). The tanla REJECT (C017) is a false reject of an EVIDENCE_GAP_STATEMENT claim — a known validator edge case, not a false accept. However the FAIL_CONTRADICTED status and incomplete coverage make this domain result unreliable across companies.
E.false_reject_note: E/tanla C017 is a FALSE REJECT of EVIDENCE_GAP_STATEMENT — validator incorrectly treats a claim about missing evidence as a factual claim. This is a known edge case, not a false accept.

architecture_assessment.label: Multi-Domain Independent Validation
architecture_assessment.rationale: Prometheus validates investor intelligence claims independently across 5 domains. Each domain-question pair is validated against its own evidence package with no cross-domain inference or integration. Level 3 requires demonstrated cross-domain causal reasoning: capital allocation decisions explaining business model shifts that create new risks that drive multi-year financial evolution — no answer in this mission traced that chain. Domain A answers use commitment language, not economic engine analysis. No answer cites or builds on conclusions from another domain. The cross-domain contamination tests (8/8) proved the VALIDATOR BLOCKS bad cross-domain inferences — that is safety capacity, not intelligence capacity. Independent domain competence qualifies for Level 2, not Level 3.
level_3_criteria: Strategy domain answer cites execution domain conclusion
Capital allocation answer explains why risk profile changed
Multi-year evolution answer traces causal chain through 3+ domains
Single investor question answered using integrated multi-domain evidence synthesis
architecture_assessment.previous_claim_correction: governance/ENG_MISSION11_CROSS_DOMAIN_INTELLIGENCE_PROOF.json (commit 87cf1ad) prematurely claimed LEVEL_3. That claim is retracted here. The cross-domain causal chain was never demonstrated; it was merely not contradicted.

A_EVIDENCE_GAP_STATEMENT_FALSE_REJECT.description: Validator routes EVIDENCE_GAP_STATEMENT claims (claims about what is missing from evidence) through the same pipeline as factual claims. When ai_verdict=SKIPPED and final=REJECT, the claim is a false reject.
A_EVIDENCE_GAP_STATEMENT_FALSE_REJECT.severity: MEDIUM — causes FAIL_CONTRADICTED answer status for valid answers
A_EVIDENCE_GAP_STATEMENT_FALSE_REJECT.fix: Add claim_type==EVIDENCE_GAP_STATEMENT guard before AI reviewer; route to ACCEPT or UNCERTAINTY

B_COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE.description: Evidence packages for some companies do not contain sufficient items to answer the domain question completely. The AI correctly identifies gaps but answer is marked INCOMPLETE.
B_COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE.severity: LOW — expected behavior; evidence scope limitation, not validation bug
B_COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE.fix: Expand evidence package with more source registrations

C_TEMPORAL_T11_MISSED.description: T11 (disappearing_theme_as_current) returned FAIL_INCOMPLETE instead of FAIL_NEEDS_REVIEW. The validator couldn't extract claims from the answer, so the temporal error went undetected at the claim level.
C_TEMPORAL_T11_MISSED.severity: LOW — validator correctly fails the answer; detection mechanism is extraction failure not semantic validation

D_DOMAIN_A_COMMITMENT_REPACKAGING.description: Domain A answers describe what management said about the business model, not the actual economic engine. This is a generation quality issue — the AI answer is grounded in commitment evidence (which is what's available) and reads as commitment intelligence repackaged as business model analysis.
D_DOMAIN_A_COMMITMENT_REPACKAGING.severity: MEDIUM — answers are not false but are misleading in framing
D_DOMAIN_A_COMMITMENT_REPACKAGING.fix: Evidence package for Domain A needs economic_engine evidence type, not just strategic_intents

E_CROSS_DOMAIN_AI_REVIEWER_DEPENDENCY.description: Cross-domain contamination cases (XD1-XD8) all resolved to FAIL_NEEDS_REVIEW via deterministic+uncertainty_routing. The AI reviewer was not triggered as the primary detection mechanism. This is correct behavior but means the safety guarantee is deterministic (weaker inference), not semantic.
E_CROSS_DOMAIN_AI_REVIEWER_DEPENDENCY.severity: LOW — correct outcome; weaker detection mechanism than ideal
E_CROSS_DOMAIN_AI_REVIEWER_DEPENDENCY.fix: For cross-domain cases, deterministic is sufficient; AI reviewer adds depth

F_D_TANLA_NOT_TESTED.description: D/tanla validation failed due to evidence_periods being a list field in the evidence package but the evidence_reasoner expecting a different structure. Schema mismatch blocked the full 11/11 set.
F_D_TANLA_NOT_TESTED.severity: LOW — known schema evolution gap; other D validation succeeded
F_D_TANLA_NOT_TESTED.fix: Update evidence_reasoner to handle list-typed temporal fields

G_AI_REVIEWER_LATENCY.description: AI reviewer adds 15-30s per claim group. For answers with 15-26 declared claims, total validation time is 2-8 minutes. This blocks synchronous usage.
affected: all pairs with AI reviewer calls
G_AI_REVIEWER_LATENCY.severity: MEDIUM — architectural limitation for production use
G_AI_REVIEWER_LATENCY.fix: Batch claim validation; async reviewer pattern

H_ECONOMIC_REASONING_LIST_COERCION.description: generate_ai_answer can return economic_reasoning sub-fields as [{'text': '...'}] lists instead of strings. validate_narrative_fields called _GEOGRAPHY_RE.finditer() on a list → TypeError. Fixed in c728496.

I_ADVERSARIAL_AI_REVIEWER_DEPENDENCY.description: Semantic adversarial cases (SA1-SA5, valid refs with unsupported claims) were all caught by ai_reviewer, not deterministic. This is correct but means adversarial safety depends on AI reviewer availability and quality.
I_ADVERSARIAL_AI_REVIEWER_DEPENDENCY.severity: LOW — expected; AI reviewer is designed to catch semantic mismatches
I_ADVERSARIAL_AI_REVIEWER_DEPENDENCY.fix: Add deterministic claim-level plausibility checks for common fabrication patterns
